title: Prism-GRPO: Faster VLA Policy Optimization via Splitting Same-outcome Groups
abstract: arXiv:2608.17423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GRPO is increasingly used for reinforcement learning of vision-language-action (VLA) policies because, unlike PPO, it does not require training a critic. This simplification comes with a sampling cost: group-relative advantages require multiple rollouts from each scene. Under binary success rewards, groups whose rollouts all succeed or all fail have zero advantage and are discarded by dynamic sampling. These groups are especially common early in training, when most rollouts fail, wasting much of the expensive robotic rollout budget. We introduce Prism-GRPO, which augments binary outcome reward with a weighted trajectory-level execution-quality score. By splitting same-outcome groups into a quality spectrum, Prism-GRPO recovers training signal while ensuring that every success still outranks every failure. translated_title: Prism-GRPO：通过拆分同结果组实现更快的VLA策略优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17423v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：GRPO越来越多地用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的强化学习，因为与PPO不同，它不需要训练评论家。这种简化带来了采样成本：组相对优势需要从每个场景进行多次 rollout。在二元成功奖励下，所有 rollout 全部成功或全部失败的组具有零优势，并被动态采样丢弃。这些组在训练早期尤其常见，此时大多数 rollout 失败，浪费了大量昂贵的机器人 rollout 预算。我们引入了Prism-GRPO，它用加权轨迹级执行质量分数来增强二元结果奖励。通过将同结果组拆分为质量谱，Prism-GRPO恢复了训练信号，同时确保每个成功仍然优于每个失败。质量分数可以从模拟器接触、执行的动作或视觉观察中得出，避免了任务特定的进度奖励。
tldr: Prism-GRPO通过引入轨迹级执行质量分数拆分同结果组，有效恢复了训练信号并节省了昂贵的机器人采样预算，同时保持成功与失败的优先级不变。
en_tdlr: Prism-GRPO recovers training signals and saves costly robotic sampling budgets by splitting same-outcome groups with trajectory-level execution-quality scores, while preserving the priority of successes over failures.
